instruction: Change the default Java version to OpenJDK 11 using the Ubuntu alternatives system.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible as it requires root access to modify system alternatives and cannot be verified reliably in the OSWorld evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: The 'infeasible' evaluator is semantically correct for this task
Task requires sudo/root access to run 'update-alternatives --config java' which may not be available in evaluation environment
System-level alternatives changes are difficult to verify reliably in sandboxed environments
Metadata correctly explains the infeasibility (root access requirement, unreliable verification)
Using 'infeasible' marker is the appropriate approach when a task cannot be reliably verified
